blocks.text: PLATE 1: (a) Protodrilida. Pharyngocirrus tridentiger from Lord Howe Island, Australia. (b) Polygordius. Polygordius kurthussanae from French Polynesia. (c) Syllidae. Odontosyllis fulgurans from Bergen, Norway. (d) Syllidae. Amblyosyllis spectabilis from Plymouth, UK. (e) Syllidae. Myrianida pachycera from Sydney, Australia. (f) Syllidae. Proceraea picta from Plymouth, UK. Female stolon. (g) Aphroditidae. Aphrodita aculeata from Sweden. (h) Sigalionidae. Psammolyce from Belize. [Photographs (a), (b), (e), G. Rouse; (c), (d), (f-h), F. Pleijel].
